copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在视频结尾制作品牌动画

howto.what: 装好后,要求它生成 Logo 收尾帧时,它会产出一个 1920×1080 的单文件 HTML 动画:Logo 分块滑入拼装、发光,品牌名和 tagline 依次浮现,末尾 CTA 显示,动画结束静止不循环。
howto.when: 当用户要求制作视频片尾、品牌闭幕或 Logo 收尾帧,并给出品牌名和 tagline 时触发。
howto.what_en: When asked for a logo outro, it produces a 1920×1080 single-file HTML: logo pieces slide in and assemble, glow bloom, then brand name, tagline and CTA appear. End state is frozen, no loop.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests a video outro, brand closing frame, or logo end-card, and provides a brand name and tagline.

say_en.text: Create a logo outro frame with brand name 'Star Dust Tech' and tagline 'Let creativity shine'.
say_en.note: Generates the HTML animation with default palette.

say_en.text: Make a Solar Amber logo outro, brand HTML Anything, use default tagline.
